Syndrome Never Wanted To End Superheroes | The Incredibles #shorts
description:
In Pixar's 2004 classic 'The Incredibles', Syndrome claims his mission is democratic: 'When everyone's super, no one will be.'

But look closely at his actual plan. He didn't build weapons to abolish heroes—he staged a catastrophic robot invasion just so he could swoop in and play the savior.

His greatest invention wasn't zero-point energy or the Omnidroid. It was an elaborate mechanism to force the world to give him the admiration he was denied as a boy.
